# Crewloom
> The Sovereign Autonomous AI Coding Agent Engineered for Zero-Destruction Autonomy.

Crewloom (https://crewloom.org) is the next-generation autonomous software development engine uniting 44 open-source specialist skills with a disciplined proprietary core, strict non-destructive verification, and an omni-channel bridge control room (Telegram, WhatsApp, Web, Terminal).

## Key Capabilities
- **Zero-Destruction Autonomy**: Every action is audited against binding architectural contracts and non-destructive AST policies before committing.
- **Dual-Core Intelligence**: Native bilingual core with full parity across English and Arabic technical vocabularies.
- **44 Specialist Skills**: Specialized autonomous skills for backend, frontend, database migrations, security audits, and cloud infrastructure.
- **Omni-Channel Bridge Mediation**: Run workflows from the CLI, macOS desktop app, Telegram, or automated background daemons.
- **Optimized Runtime**: Sub-millisecond IPC design target (<0.8ms) with zero configuration and local offline inference support.

## Quick Installation
```bash
# Universal One-Step Installer (macOS & Linux)
curl -fsSL https://crewloom.org/install.sh | bash
```

## Core Architecture
- **Layer 01 - Crewloom Core (Open-Source)**: Repository holding 44 specialist skill definitions, shared working memory, and toolchain connectors.
- **Layer 02 - Crewloom Bridge (Open-Source)**: Omni-channel mediator linking terminal execution to remote communication apps.
- **Layer 03 - Agent Engine (Proprietary)**: High-discipline execution engine with binding constitution and contract-driven AST verification.
